contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [CONSTAN]TINVS IVN NOB [C]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; ?M on vexillum. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 13.6mm, Weight: 0.90gms, die axis: 12
